definitions.gloss: contribution of an article; written submission
definitions.explanation: The act of writing and submitting an article, essay, or other piece of writing to a newspaper, magazine, journal, or website. Also refers to the submitted piece itself.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}に{寄稿|きこう}した。
examples.english: I contributed an article to the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}が{雑誌|ざっし}に{寄稿|きこう}した{記事|きじ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read an article contributed by an expert to a magazine.

examples.japanese: {教授|きょうじゅ}から{学会誌|がっかいし}への{寄稿|きこう}を{依頼|いらい}された。
examples.english: I was asked by a professor to contribute to an academic journal.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in publishing and academic contexts. Often used with する to form a verb ({寄稿|きこう}する). The contributor is called {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄稿|きこう}する (to contribute an article)
- {寄稿|きこう}を{依頼|いらい}する (to request a contribution)
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ} (contributor)
- {寄稿|きこう}{記事|きじ} (contributed article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投稿|とうこう}: submission, post — broader, includes social media posts, letters to editors, and user-generated content
- {執筆|しっぴつ}: writing — the act of writing itself, not specifically submitting to a publication
